text: {"label": "Treating Pediatric Food Refusal","definition": "Behavioral treatment of children's food refusal and selectivity, including escape extinction, extinction bursts, alternatives without escape extinction, multicomponent packages, treatment integrity, and community or telehealth delivery.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Centers on treating active food refusal, not functional analysis of mealtime behavior, basic food-schedule research and food-presentation methods, or broad assessment-and-treatment overviews of pediatric feeding disorders."}
